faqs.a:
The provisions of this article shall apply to the various interests to be acquired
               by the city in real property, including all improvements thereon, according to the
               intended use and purpose of the property. The provisions of this article shall further
               apply to development of real property within the city, or property to be annexed into
               the city, which property may, upon reasonable belief on the part of the city, constitute
               a danger or threat to the health, safety, and welfare of the citizens due to a condition
               of environmental contamination by hazardous substances as defined herein.
(Code 1981, § 25-82; Ord. No. 3009, § 1, 10-4-1993)
